import requests
# Fetch BERT config (using an alias 'bert-uncased' available in our environment)

bert_cfg = requests.get(bert_url).json()
print("BERT config keys:", list(bert_cfg.keys()))
print("num_hidden_layers:", bert_cfg.get("num_hidden_layers"))

# For the original Transformer, pull a summary page that states encoder layers
